inventory_method: Reused test_runtime_egress._discovered_fetch_sinks and DECLARED_FETCH_SINKS; manually traced caller reachability and SDK/browser/TLS sinks the AST walker does not model.
hardened_setting: ENABLE_LOCAL_WEB_FETCH=False, the product setting used by the ENABLE_RAG_LOCAL_WEB_FETCH compatibility alias.
transport_scope: Offline socket.getaddrinfo and fake HTTP boundaries preserve requests redirects/adapters and aiohttp redirects/connector guards; MCP uses httpx.MockTransport. No installed dependencies or real network/DNS.
limits: Remote Firecrawl/external/Tavily/Microsoft crawlers execute target redirects and DNS outside this process. Tests establish URL admission and outbound service calls, not remote-service enforcement.
No URL port allow-list exists in these fetch paths. The separate TLS probe always uses port 443.
Admin-configured private services are allowed by design. Tests attack derived URLs and responses rather than rejecting every configured private base URL.
YouTube findings require simulated trusted YouTube DNS or redirect tampering; ordinary non-admin control of those is not established.
Document-extraction findings require control of an extraction service response; ordinary document bytes alone have not been shown to select those URLs.
OAuth metadata findings require malicious or compromised configured service/provider responses; picture claims are separately user-controlled.
Unguarded sinks have no validation-time DNS lookup. Their rebinding tests change DNS across redirects; guarded sinks change DNS between real validation and connection resolution.
Environment proxies are removed in offline tests. Safe-session docstrings delegate destination resolution to configured proxies, which require their own policy.

meta_test.reason: The existing walker recognizes calls and session factories at module scope, not interprocedural URL provenance, dominating guards, admin dependencies or browser delegation. A module rule conflates legitimate configured internal services with untrusted derived URLs. A reliable extension here would require the sink table/allow-list the request excludes; reused the walker for inventory instead.
